paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: use the agent running on your own computer from your phone or browser
— bridge to the HarnessMate platform.
HarnessMate — a DeepSeek Harness plugin
Put the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer into your pocket.
English · 中文
`harness-mate` is a DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin. It connects the DSH agent running on your machi
ne to **HarnessMate** — a small self-hostable platform that gives that agent a phone app and a brows
arnessMate** — a small self-hostable platform that gives that agent a phone app and a browser entry.
The agent keeps running on your own computer, with your files and your approvals. HarnessMate is jus
t the door: open it from the phone in your pocket or from a browser anywhere.
## What it does
- **Chat from anywhere.** Send the agent a message from the phone app or the web UI; streamed replie

s arrive with a typing indicator.
- **Files both ways.** Send the agent files from the phone; the ag

ent can send files back.
- **Approvals on your phone.** When the agent asks to run a risky tool, the

request is pushed to you — approve or deny from the chat, instead of being tied to the computer.
-
**Keeps your machine in charge.** Tools run locally with your permissions, under your DSH profile. H

arnessMate never executes anything on its own.
- **Model-agnostic and profile-aware.** It talks to w

hatever model your DSH profile is configured with.
- **macOS and Windows.**
## Install

You need a HarnessMate agent — a `bot_id` and a `bot_key`.
Open the platform (`https://harness.alltm
an.com` by default), sign in, go to **个人空间 → 创建智能体**, and copy both values. **The key is shown only
by default), sign in, go to **个人空间 → 创建智能体**, and copy both values. **The key is shown only once.**
> DeepSeek Harness desktop **v0.2.0-rc.2 or newer**, started at least once, is required.

### Both options finish the same way
**Quit DeepSeek Harness completely** (menu bar / tray icon → Quit — not just close the window) and s
tart it again. Then send the agent a message from the phone app or the web UI: **a reply means it wo
rks.** Logs are written to `~/.harness-mate-trace.log` (`%USERPROFILE%\.harness-mate-trace.log` on W
ogs are written to `~/.harness-mate-trace.log` (`%USERPROFILE%\.harness-mate-trace.log` on Windows).
Detailed instructions, FAQ and the full configuration reference: **INSTALL.md**.
## Configuration
Every field lives under `config` in the plugin's `cordis.patch.yml`; change them and restart DSH.
| field | default | meaning |

| `gatewayUrl` | HarnessMate's gateway | The WebSocket gateway the plugin connects to |
| `botId` /

`botKey` | — | This agent's identity on the platform (**required**) |
| `workspace` | your home dire

ctory | Root directory the agent may read and write |
| `dmPolicy` | `open` | `open` · `allowlist` (

with `allowFrom`) · `disabled` |
| `approvalTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Tool-approval timeout; a timeout

is treated as a denial |
| `apiBaseUrl` | derived from `uploadUrl` | Platform HTTP API root (incl.

`/api`) for approval polling |
| `internalToken` | — | Must match platform `INTERNAL_TOKEN`; without

it polling is disabled |
| `agentId` | — | Agent UUID; defaults to lookup by `botId` |
| `maxReplyC

hars` | `4000` | Maximum length of a single reply |
| `forwardReasoning` | `false` | Also forward th
e agent's reasoning to the chat |
